name: Yishun
summary: North NSL town with Northpoint / hub errands and value HDB stock — self-contained amenities with longer CBD rides and a loud internet reputation that overstates daily life.
body: Yishun is the value north shortlist when AMK rents firm up and you still want North-South Line access plus a full town centre. Yishun and Khatib MRT, Northpoint City, and dense kopitiam / supermarket coverage make car-light living workable; nature edges (Lower Seletar, park connectors) are the weekend counterweight to the meme reputation. Housing is overwhelmingly HDB with newer and older stock mixed by precinct — whole-flat rents often undercut central-north mature towns for the same bedroom count. Commute honesty check: NSL to CBD is longer than Toa Payoh / Bishan; west-side offices punish you without a car. Watch-outs: estate-level variance (hub-adjacent vs quiet interior), occasional construction / upgrading, and bedroom-rental continuous-occupation rules. Compare with Woodlands for north interchange + JB adjacency, Ang Mo Kio for shorter NSL hops with denser hawkers, or Sengkang if you prefer NEL / newer northeast flats.
bestFor: NSL workers okay with longer rides
watchOuts: Longer CBD commute than central-north towns
Hub vs interior noise and crowd gaps
Internet reputation ≠ block-level reality — walk it
HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval checks
housingMix: HDB dominant (older and newer precincts), limited condo pockets.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Yishun / Khatib; verify feeder buses if your block is far from the hub.
